turns.text: Hello, I just opened my delivery and the print has a deep crease along the corner.

I'm sorry your print arrived damaged. To file a damage claim, I need your order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address the order was placed with. Once I have them, I'll record the crease and staff will ask you for a photo and decide on the next step.
Order SC-4090, email is emily.clark.v2@example.com. Please file a damage claim for a refund.

Thank you, Emily. I've filed a damage claim (R-1) for order SC-4090, the Whispering Pines print, asking for a refund because of the deep crease along the corner. Staff must approve it. They will ask you for a photo of the damage and make the decision, so nothing is refunded yet.

change.description: Customer reports a deep crease along the corner of the print (Whispering Pines, 40x50 cm) on delivery.

turns.text: Actually, I really love the art itself. Could I please get a reprint instead of a refund?

Of course, Emily. I've updated damage claim R-1 for order SC-4090 to ask for a reprint of the Whispering Pines print instead of a refund. It is still pending, and staff must approve it. They will ask you for a photo of the crease and make the final decision.
